title: Make the webkit-verify focus-ring probe enforcing after one green production deploy
evidence: From PR 1627 (US-62 AC10b). tools/webkit-verify.mjs runs assertFocusRing through advisory(): it prints 'focus rings verified' or 'focus ring probe FAILED (advisory): ...' and never fails verify-live, because it has run only on the Mac and verify-live runs Linux WebKit. Once one production Deploy's verify-live log shows 'focus rings verified' on all four devices, call assertFocusRing directly and delete the TODO (H90). (H90)
